# Appendix A
## 1. Model selection and fit
```{r, echo = F}
tablea1 <- read.csv('~/Documents/Davis/R-Projects/organicseed_adoption/tables/tablea1.csv') ; 
colnames(tablea1) <- c("Term", rep(c("Mean", "SE"), 5)) ; 
tablea1[is.na(tablea1)] <- "" ; 
kbl(tablea1, booktabs = T, caption = 'Model comparison results') %>% kable_styling(latex_options = "scale_down") %>% 
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Model 1" = 2, "Model 2" = 2, "Model 3" = 2, "Model 4" = 2, "Model 5" = 2))
```
```{r, echo = F}
tablea2 <- read.csv('~/Documents/Davis/R-Projects/organicseed_adoption/tables/tablea2.csv') ; 
colnames(tablea2) <- c("Model", "WAIC", "Maximum Likelihood", "CPO") ; 
kbl(tablea2, booktabs = T, caption = 'Goodness of fit across models') 
```
## 2. Full model results
```{r, echo = F}
tablea3 <- read.csv('~/Documents/Davis/R-Projects/organicseed_adoption/tables/tablea3.csv') ; 
colnames(tablea3) <- c("Term", "Mean estimate", "Standard error") ; 
kbl(tablea3, booktabs = T, caption = 'Full model results') %>% kable_styling(latex_options = "scale_down")  
```
